traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text:
While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is
indistinguishable from a weathered, inanimate statue that is covered in
fungus, lichen, and moss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The margoyle makes three attacks: one with its bite and
two with its claws; it can gore once with its horns instead of using its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft.; one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10
(2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7
(1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
